risks.risk: Item mismatch/scam risk: seller describes a colour MFP printer, but witness saw a boxed HP desktop computer.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact item being sold (showing the printer/MFP nameplate or the desktop model label) and a short video of the device powering on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a boxed HP desktop PC with unknown model/spec and unknown working status (worst case: untested/possibly non-functional).

risks.risk: Unknown desktop model/spec (CPU/RAM/storage) because the model label is not readable.
risks.proof: One close-up photo of the desktop’s model/spec sticker (or BIOS/System Information screen) showing CPU, RAM, and storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for an HP desktop with unknown specs (worst case: minimal RAM/storage).

risks.risk: Not sure if it is complete (monitor/keyboard/mouse) or system unit only.
risks.proof: Photo showing everything included laid out (system unit, monitor, keyboard, mouse, power cable, and any accessories).
risks.if_unproven: Price as system unit only (worst case: no monitor/keyboard/mouse).

risks.risk: Condition/physical damage not visible through outer packaging.
risks.proof: Video walk-around of the unit (corners/ports/side panels) after opening the box, showing no dents/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/untested due to lack of visible condition checks.

risks.proof: Short power-on video showing BIOS/boot screen and that it reaches the desktop (or POST) without errors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as untested (worst case: may not boot).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the HP desktop model/spec label (or a screenshot of System Information) showing CPU, RAM, and storage.
Confirm what is included: system unit only vs full set (monitor, keyboard, mouse, cables). Send a photo of all items laid out.
Provide a power-on/boot video to confirm it works (show BIOS/boot and no error beeps).
If the seller truly has a colour MFP, send photos of the actual printer/MFP model nameplate and a page counter/print test; otherwise confirm the listing is for the desktop PC shown.
response.reason: The witness report identifies a boxed HP desktop PC, while the seller’s claims are about a colour MFP printer; without proof of the actual item and its working/spec details, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
